result.title: AROMA: Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation for Vision-Language Model Control
result.summary: Mechanistic localization does not by itself yield usable control: causal sensitivity may occupy little activation energy, an accurate local direction may fail at finite scale, and a reachable numeral target may be wrong. We introduce AROMA (Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation), a frozen-VLM control framework separating where to intervene, which geometry and gain to use, how to reach a target, which target to pursue, and when to act. In Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, four dimensions of a causally validated cross-attention head explain 89.82% of cardinality sensitivity but only 9.52% of median activation energy; magnitude-normalized causal subspace actuation converts this mismatch into finite control, improving exact-count accuracy on untouched procedural data by +8.00 pp. Iterative Minimal-Effort Actuation (MEA) reaches 81.25% of oracle targets versus 15.18% for a frozen direction under matched step budgets. With target and gate frozen before evaluation, targeted MEA improves the previous frozen policy from 34.444% to 38.730% on a new natural Stage-2 cohort (N=630; paired p=4.63e-7) and yields 65.741% versus 65.153% over all 7,992 examples while editing only 63 inputs. Prospective routing, replication across heads and models, and comparisons with attribution-steering baselines further characterize each stage, separating localization, actuation, reachability, target quality, and selective deployment as distinct control problems.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AROMA，一个冻结 VLM 的表示控制框架，把「在哪里干预、用何种几何与增益、能否到达目标、追求哪个目标、何时行动」拆成独立环节，并在 Llama-3.2-11B-Vision 的交叉注意力头上用因果验证的子空间、幅值归一化干预与迭代最小努力搜索提升计数准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「任务必要视觉信息是否存在于内部状态、输出是否真正使用该 latent 内容」：其因果敏感度只占 9.52% 激活能量的失配，以及仅编辑 63/7992 个输入的选择性部署，可供核查视觉证据筛选与 STOP 式「何时行动」的收益–成本判断。
